title: The Plague Cart
text: A cart rolls in at dawn with no driver and no horse, creaking through the open gate on its own. Its cargo is shrouded and humming with flies, and something under the cloth is moving. The physicians want it; the priests want it burned.

options.label: Burn it, cart and all, before whatever moves under the cloth gets out.

outcomes.text: The smoke is black and smells of honey. For a week the bees of the city swarm toward the ashes.

options.label: Quarantine it outside the walls, and let the guards keep watch.

outcomes.text: It rots in a field, watched by nervous guards. Nothing grows there after.
Something crawls from it in the night and is never found. Sometimes, in the lower town, a door is found open in the morning.

options.label: Let the physicians study what moves under the cloth, whatever it costs them.

outcomes.text: The physicians learn much, and the Apothecary's shelves fill with new tinctures, some of which move.
The physicians learn much, and two of them die of it, smiling. The fever spreads to a House.
